kaitlyn: Heads-up — we're kicking off a quick QA thread on TLS hardening across regions. Question bundle: cipher suites we enforce, how cert private keys are stored/rotated (KMS/HSM), RBAC for rotation, and what to do about the intermittent handshake failures in eu-west-1.

maria: Can you share the exact failure pattern? 502 handshake? client hello mismatch?

kaitlyn: Saw increased TLS handshake failures from some EU mobile clients around 08:12 UTC, TLS alerts show 'protocol_version' then connection drop. No obvious server-side cert errors in first glance.

samir: That typically means client only supports TLS1.2 and server dropped it. Did we recently push a policy change in the CDN or ALB?

kaitlyn: Not intentionally. We did roll out a cipher-policy update in staging last night — intended to remove weak ciphers. Rollout to prod was gated but maybe a config drift applied in eu.

devon: I can check ALB listener config and nginx upstreams. Quick checklist: ALB supports TLS1.2/1.3; nginx may be configured to only accept TLS1.3 if ssl_protocols changed.

maria: For hardening, recommendation we want across all regions: keep TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 enabled for now, but restrict cipher list to AEAD-only. Example nginx snippet: ```
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
```

samir: Also ensure TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 is present for ECDSA certs. For RSA certs prefer AES-GCM variants.

kaitlyn: Great. Now KMS question — we currently store cert private keys in SSM Parameter Store encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key. Is that still the right pattern or should we move to CloudHSM for private key operations?

devon: For short term, CMK + SSM is fine if access is limited and key policy audited. CloudHSM is better if we must meet FIPS-level attestation or if key material must never leave HSM. It depends on compliance — CC/PCI?

maria: For our current enterprise customers asking about FIPS, we should document option to use CloudHSM for Private deployments. Hosted customers can use CMK + KMS import if needed.

kaitlyn: RBAC: who should be able to rotate certs? Proposed role: cert-rotator with permission to decrypt SSM param, update secrets, trigger deploy jobs, but not modify KMS key policy. Thoughts?

samir: Agree. Principle of least privilege. Also require MFA for any manual rotation actions. Add audit log entries for rotation actions in CloudTrail and push alerts to #incidents when rotation occurs out-of-band.

maria: Don't forget to annotate rotations with change_request_id and link to ticket. That helps quality/regressions tracking.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Rolling config diff applied to eu-west-1 edge (ID: cb3f7). No certs changed.

kaitlyn: devon, can you confirm whether that diff included the ssl_protocols change?

devon: Looking at the diff now — it updated cipher list on edge nodes only, not origin nginx. I see `ssl_ciphers` change to a stricter list and a new `ssl_protocols` line enabling TLSv1.3 only on those edge boxes by mistake. That's likely the root cause.

samir: Oof. So immediate mitigation: revert edge `ssl_protocols` to include TLSv1.2, then schedule a staged rollout with client telemetry gating.

kaitlyn: I'll open a rollback and incident ticket. tagging oncall. @oncall can you patch eu edge to re-enable TLS1.2 and confirm?

oncall: Patch started. ETA ~8 minutes. I'll post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: After mitigation, follow-up items: 1) enforce central policy for TLS/cipher config in infra repo so edge diffs can't diverge; 2) add pre-deploy check to CI that validates `ssl_protocols` includes TLSv1.2 unless a feature flag is set; 3) document cert rotation RBAC and KMS storage options.

devon: For CI check we can add a small linter that parses nginx conf and asserts cipher list matches whitelist. I'll draft MR.

samir: For audit/logging: CloudTrail already captures KMS decrypts. Add a daily query in Athena for any decrypts by `cert-rotator` role and alert on anomalies. Also log rotation actions to our audit S3 prefix.

kaitlyn: Thanks all. For the follow-up: I'll create a ticket to (A) revert eu edge, (B) add CI lint, (C) propose RBAC policy, (D) write ops runbook for cert rotation with KMS vs HSM decision tree.

oncall: eu patch complete — traffic healthy, error rate back to baseline :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. One more ops note — if we do CloudHSM, we need to support ECDSA key import quirks; test vectors needed. Put that on Research backlog.

kaitlyn: OK — I'll assign tasks in the ticket. If anyone wants to add specifics to the runbook draft, drop them in the ticket. Thanks! :sparkles:
